sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Let me try clicking on a white dot with MOUSE
# Find a white dot near the player
seg = current_frame.segmentation
white_dots = []
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'W' and n['pixels'] == 1:
        white_dots.append(n['boundary'][0])

print(f"White dots: {sorted(white_dots)}")

# Find closest white dot to player center (31, 21)
player_center = (31, 21)
closest_dot = None
closest_dist = float('inf')
for dot in white_dots:
    dist = abs(dot[0] - player_center[0]) + abs(dot[1] - player_center[1])
    if dist < closest_dist:
        closest_dist = dist
        closest_dot = dot

print(f"Closest white dot: {closest_dot}, distance: {closest_dist}")

# Try clicking on the closest white dot
if closest_dot:
    result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': closest_dot[0], 'col': closest_dot[1]}])
    
    # Check if white dot count changed
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    white_count = sum(1 for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'W' and n['pixels'] == 1)
    print(f"White dot count after click: {white_count}")
    
    # Check player position
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] == 'O':
            print(f"Player after click: {n['boundary']}")
    
    # Check result
    print(f"Result: board_changed={last_action_result.get('board_changed')}, level_completed={last_action_result.get('level_completed')}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
